messages:
Maria (PM): heads up - customer Acme wants embedding dim change support without rerank breaks. asks: 1) soft-deploy, 2) deterministic fallback, 3) no perf regression.
Kevin (ML Eng): ack. current plan? we changed dims in q4 for a smaller quantized model. main risk is rerank scoring shift and normalized dot vs cosine mismatch.
Samir (Infra): also watch batch path. batching currently pads to max dim and zero-pads — can that break cosine normalization at scale?
Jess (SWE): idea: runtime shim to project old dims into new space using a learned linear map when version mismatch detected. cheap and can be cached per-model-pair.
Olivia (Customer Success): Acme cares about sign-off criteria: accuracy delta <2% on top-1 rerank, no latency +10ms p90, and rollback must be trivial.
Kevin (ML Eng): proposed acceptance criteria:
- regression <=2% on evaluation rerank set (bench/rerank-small)
- p95 latency <= current +10ms
- canary traffic ramp 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automated rollback on metric regressions
- logs must include embed_version, projection_used, and similarity_metric
Samir (Infra): ops checklist:
- feature flag: enable_embedding_projection
- telemetry counters: projection_hits, projection_latency_ms, projection_failures
- canary script: deploy to region us-west-2 first
- rollback playbook: pin to previous model binary + disable flag
Maria (PM): scope negotiation: ship projection shim + small eval harness this sprint. defer auto-retrain projection and model-store changes to next quarter.
Jess (SWE): quick patch for runtime sketch:
```
if request.embed_version != model.expected_version:
  vec = fetch_cached_projection(old=new, key=(request.embed_version, model.version))
  if vec is None:
    vec = apply_linear_projection(request.vector)
    cache.store(key, vec)
  route_to_rerank(vec)
else:
  route_to_rerank(request.vector)
```
Kevin (ML Eng): edge cases we need in RFC and tests: partial NaNs, zero vectors from padding, batched normalization order (normalize-before-aggregate vs after), mixed-batch dims, and metric shifts for long-tail queries. include randomized seed checks.
Olivia (Customer Success): I'll draft customer-facing rollout note + acceptance checklist. also confirm legal about storing projection maps for customer-owned models. cc @Maria
ci-bot: test-suite started: rerank-regression-tests / 48 jobs (job 1/48 running)
Maria (PM): ok great. action owners: Kevin -> projection prototype (EOW), Jess -> runtime flag + canary implementation, Samir -> telemetry + rollback playbook, Olivia -> customer comms; I'll own the QA acceptance sign-off. sync Fri 11:00am PT. :thumbsup:
